'''Samala Reyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], where she managed a small shop in the [[Promenade]] area.
